posts.name: Gary Black
posts.text: I’ve long felt that a $SPCX - $TSLA deal is inevitable since Elon controls 48% of $SPCX as-converted shares and 10.5% of TSLA shares. Since any deal would be $SPCX stock for $TSLA stock the deal will not be as compelling as many on X believe, given the massive dilution and all-equity economics.  I expect a SPCX offer price in the neighborhood of $420/TSLA share, and as in most stock-for-stock deals will likely get arbitraged down given the approximate 6-12 months needed between a deal announcement and deal close.
posts.why: Gary Black calls a deal inevitable given Musk's voting control and pegs a likely all-stock SpaceX offer near $420 per Tesla share, with 6 to 12 months from announcement to close; picked up by Benzinga and Bloomberg on Oct 20.
